title: What Really Determines the Price of an Option?
summary: What really goes into the price of an option? Jeff Praissman and Mat Cashman of the Options Industry Council break down intrinsic and extrinsic value, implied volatility, time decay, delta, gamma, and the forces that can move an option’s premium.
